record_title: Exact energy obstruction to the claimed Hopf-Langford torus bifurcation
provenance: A source-specific correction and exact amplitude classification for the Hopf-Langford-type system studied in arXiv:2609.18010v1.
limitations: Applies to the rotationally symmetric four-parameter source system on r>0 near its nonzero periodic circle; it does not rule out torus bifurcations in broader Hopf-Langford models with additional terms, and it does not locate the exact symbolic step causing the source averaging discrepancy.
